mentions.name: Petrify
mentions.description: Petrify is a machine learning model compiler for the JVM. It reads models from ONNX or other model formats, walks tree or linear models, and encodes them as equivalent JVM bytecode in a stateless class that can be invoked directly. Unlike interpreter-based ONNX runtimes, it compiles models to native bytecode, yielding a much simpler setup with zero dependencies.
mentions.problem: Existing ONNX runtimes are essentially interpreters that are huge (90+ MB), JNI-based, and drag in gargantuan dependencies.
